row.notes: Walks the name->slot map at sel+0x68 and allocates frontend scene slots (FindOrCreateNewCustomCar for one key, FindOrCreateNewCustomDriver otherwise, slot id stored at node+0x58). Then resolves the team entity (self+0x40 via Sess_ResolveEntityHandle), builds a VehicleCustomisation from scene spawn params plus Ent_Get_VehicleCustomisation livery and places it in slot "car" at spawn point "VehicleSpawn1"; for each driver handle in the set at sel+8 it finds the entrant record (stride 0x88, id at +0x50) and calls Game_FrontendSceneManager_SetupCustomDriver for slot "driver_1"/"driver_2" at "DriverSpawn1"/"DriverSpawn2" with anim "CustomisationIdle". Throws if a slot key is missing. Good hook to change showroom spawn names or idle anim.
